latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Minecraft Parkour Video Maker Free.

- Instantly edits Minecraft parkour clips with AI — cut failed jumps, add speed ramps, and sync cuts to music.
- Upload up to 500MB MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files; export finished 1080p MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- No editing software knowledge required; just describe your edit and get a polished video.
- Free tier: automatic anonymous token with 100 credits (7-day expiry); no registration required.
- Full cloud-based workflow with live session, timeline preview, credit tracking, and error handling.
- Designed for Minecraft content creators who want pro-quality parkour editing, fast and free.
